visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot introduces a small, cylindrical portable stove with a transparent glass body and a dark metal frame. Inside, a bright orange flame burns steadily, casting a warm glow. The setting is indoors, positioned against a large window that reveals a blurred, foggy mountainous landscape under overcast lighting. A yellow caption '最新款觀火爐開箱' is overlaid at the top. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot showing a person's hands dressed in a green jacket. They are carefully pulling the glass stove out of a black protective bag and a crinkling clear plastic wrap. The background remains the same indoor setting near the window, with natural daylight illuminating the textures of the fabric and plastic. (3) A close-up focus shows the man using a handheld metal gas torch to ignite the stove's wick. The camera highlights the intricate star-shaped metal design at the top and the reflection of the torch's blue flame on the glass. The background is slightly dark, emphasizing the brightness of the ignition process. (4) The character sits inside a green camping tent, wearing a dark green jacket. He holds the new silver-colored stove in his left hand and an older black model in his right, comparing their sizes. His facial expression is focused and communicative as he speaks to the camera. The tent interior provides a soft, diffused lighting environment. (5) The camera provides several macro close-ups of the stove's base, specifically focusing on a brass-colored adjustment screw. The man's fingers demonstrate how to turn the screw to adjust the internal air diffusion plate. Detailed shots show the internal metal components and how they interact with the flame, illustrating technical functionality.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 最新款觀火爐開箱. (2) [Subtitle]: 新的小爐 這個比上次那個 Valor 65c 還要小. [Logo]: @SPRINGCHILL. (3) [Subtitle]: 是不是很精緻 都是為了妳喔 所以我可以一邊泡湯 然後一邊看著暖爐 一邊看著風景. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後我們這次燒這個新的這個 春山的這個小暖爐. (5) [Subtitle]: 會買這個是 它跟我喜歡的那種 彩虹爐啊 還有像 Valor 65c 啊 這種有大玻璃的爐 原理很像. (6) [Subtitle]: 就它們都很怕風 風一來就燃燒不完全 所以這兩個爐 基本上都建議燒的是石蠟油 這樣突然風吹的時候呢 比較不會有煙 或者燃燒不完全的時候 味道不會這麼臭. (7) [Subtitle]: 這一個爐呢 它其實有玻璃 但是沒有什麼那種玻璃反射的效果 但它有一個特色是 中間其實這邊有一個螺桿 從底下來這邊調整 它其實是可以調整這個 這邊有一個擋片的高低位置 目的呢 是用來調整這個 底下這邊空氣從中間上去之後 往外面擴散的一個角度 調整到燃燒比較好 但是也就是比較好啦 沒辦法到就是完全不怕風 或者甚至調到藍火 因為它的煙囪效應不夠 但是整體來說還算是一個 收納小的一個爐 所以定位就跟小壁爐很像 算是 OK.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a bright, plucked acoustic guitar track playing a melodic folk-style tune at around 90 BPM. A male narrator introduces the stove with a clear, professional, yet friendly voice. The vocal pitch is moderate, and the delivery is well-articulated, recorded with high-quality studio-like clarity. (2) A series of high-frequency rustling and crinkling sounds are introduced into the mix as the stove is unboxed. These Foley-like sounds are crisp and have high transient energy, indicating the removal of plastic packaging. The BGM continues steadily in the background at a lower volume. (3) A sharp mechanical click followed by the steady, broadband hiss of a pressurized gas torch is heard. The sound of the flame igniting adds a low-frequency hum. The narrator's voice maintains its steady pace, occasionally pausing to let the sound of the torch be heard. (4) The vocal delivery becomes more descriptive as the scene moves to the tent. The acoustic environment shifts slightly to a flatter tone, but the narration remains dominant. The guitar music stays consistent, providing a warm, rhythmic bed under the speech without any sudden changes in tempo or key. (5) Short, subtle 'whoosh' and 'pop' sound effects are used as sonic punctuation during visual transitions. These SFX are brief and placed precisely at the cuts to enhance the production quality. The track ends with a final concluding sentence from the narrator and a gentle fade-out of the music.
